name: Fonebox Retail Ltd
about: Fonebox Retail Limited is a multi-brand retailer of smartphones and accessories from brands like Vivo, Apple, Samsung, Oppo, Realme, Nokia, Narzo, Redmi, Motorola, LG, and Micromax.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Fonebox Retail Limited operates a retail chain specializing in consumer electronics, with a significant focus on mobile phones, accessories, and related services. The company offers a multi-brand retail experience and aims to deliver high-quality products at competitive rates, encapsulated in its tagline "Best Brands Best Rates"[2]

pros: Promoter holding has increased by 0.89% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
